description: Defines the Content entity model class for a content management system, including fields like id, descriptions, merchant store, code, visibility, content position, and content type. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping and manages content properties.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Entity class representing content data including descriptions, merchant association, visibility, positioning, and type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key (ID) of the content entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key (ID) of the content entity.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this content.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this content.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifier for the content.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier for the content.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Returns whether the content is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility status of the content.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of content descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of content descriptions.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type grouping (BOX, SECTION, PAGE).

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the first description if available, else null.
